decisions.reason: As a multi-model dietary supplement range closely aligned with the firm's consumer-health expansion and presented prominently, it embodies enough sunk investment and public commitment that management is likely to persist.

This skin-and-hair supplement was publicly launched as a pharmacy innovation within the firm's established offer, so disappointing results can still be justified as temporary and not yet worth admitting failure.
The joint-health supplement was first introduced as new and then given its own page, signaling a committed extension of the Trivital platform that management would be reluctant to reverse quickly.
Although more niche, it was promoted as an innovative and newest product in the range, and that visible commitment makes withdrawal harder to justify unless weakness is unmistakably persistent.

A generic blood-pressure medicine involves meaningful regulatory, manufacturing, and reputational investment, and the valsartan issue can be framed as a temporary external setback rather than a reason to abandon the product.

The OTC migraine triptan is a more distant single-product bet, but it still fits the firm's stated portfolio-broadening strategy and carries enough launch effort that management is likely to give it more time.
